value.notes: Turn 1: first probe. Testing pause input race (pause+left should ignore the left move), dash recharge display, and resume via enter. Observe player position, dashCooldown, and mode after each tick.

Turn 2: Suspected input race: pause+left in same tick moved the player (events [pause, move]) although pause should ignore rest of tick input. Verifying minimal: right, pause+left. Expect player stays at (2,1) paused; bug if at (1,1). Next: test other items (dash through items, lever, gates, timer, heart cap, Enter on dialogs, restart) if budget allows.

Confirmed one input-race bug. Pausing in the same tick as a movement key still moves the player: pause+left (after one right step) produced events [pause, move] and the player went from (2,1) to (1,1), while the design says the rest of the tick's input is ignored once paused. Reproduced in run 2 and in run 1 (same seed, same token). Not yet tested: other items, lever/gates, timer, heart cap, dialog Enter/buttons, and restart. Budget left is ample, but I stopped here to keep the single confirmed report clean.

reports.title: Movement key pressed in the same tick as pause still moves the player
reports.observed: With seed 1, after 'right' the player is at (2,1). The tick 'pause+left' produces events [pause, move]; the game pauses (mode paused, pause menu open) but the player ends at (1,1), so the left move was applied.
reports.expected: Pause takes effect immediately and the rest of that tick's input is ignored, so the player should stay at (2,1) with the game paused and nothing else happening in that tick.
